results.text: Acute enhanced liquid aspirin administration improves performance and intestinal function in nursery pigs. Aspirin (acetylsalicylic acid) is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug which has been a widely used analgesic for pain relief as well as an anti-inflammatory medication. However, it also causes negative effects on the gastrointestinal (GI) tract including GI bleeding, peptic ulcers, and can also impact the small intestine.
